name: left-x10
prompt: Swing LEFT ten times, at your own pace: a short sweep round to the left that stops, like a stick on a drum. Let the hand come back between swings.

name: front-x10
prompt: Hit FRONT ten times, at your own pace: tip the front edge down and stop, like a stick hitting a drum in front of you.

name: right-x10
prompt: Swing RIGHT ten times, at your own pace: a short sweep round to the right that stops.

name: back-x10
prompt: Hit BACK ten times, at your own pace: tip the front edge up (the back down) and stop.

name: fast-left
prompt: FAST LEFT: as many LEFT swings as you can in 5 seconds.

name: front-right-fast
prompt: FRONT, then RIGHT, fast, eight pairs: FRONT RIGHT FRONT RIGHT ...

name: drag
prompt: DRAG: swing LEFT, then pull the box back slowly. Five times.

name: return
prompt: RETURN: swing LEFT and let your hand come back by itself, as it wants to. Ten times.

name: twist
prompt: TWIST: turn your wrist back and forth for 5 seconds, like turning a door handle. No swings.

name: hold-still
prompt: HOLD STILL: hold the box in your hand, as still as you can, for 5 seconds.

name: shake
prompt: SHAKE the box for 5 seconds, any way you like.

name: tilt-slowly
prompt: TILT SLOWLY: tip the box slowly around, every way, for 10 seconds. No swings. (For NOTES.)

name: free
prompt: FREE: play it as you like for 20 seconds.
